sloka: आच्छादिताः ते वासोभिः पुष्पैः गन्धैः च पूजिताः ।सप्त ऋषयो दीप्तिमन्तो विराजन्ते यथा दिवि ॥१-१४-२७॥
transliteration: ācchāditāḥ te vāsobhiḥ puṣpaiḥ gandhaiḥ ca pūjitāḥ ।sapta ṛṣayo dīptimanto virājante yathā divi ॥1-14-27॥

translations.english: That sacrificial altar of the lion among kings, (Dasaratha), erected by welltrained brahmins was in the shape of the golden winged 'Garuda' it had three ranges and thrice as many fireplaces i.e eighteen in number.
translations.hindi: देश-देश के राजाओं को बुलाने के लिए दूत भेजे ओर स्त्रयं भी वसिष्ठ जी की आज्ञा के अनसार, राजाओं को लाने के लिए | रवाना हुए
